title: Record the rotating-normal rank-two closure
body:
## Summary
- Six rotating-normal steps move the inactive address axis through `0, 1, 8, 15, 22, 29, 36` and stop in dimension 43.
- The rank histogram is `{1: 6, 6: 6, 7: 6}`, so the uncorrected mass is 84. The rank-two address correction makes the paid mass `86 = 43 * 2`.
- The zero-saving bill is exactly 1. At saving `1/499` the corrected lower bound exceeds 1, while one extra rank-one child without that correction stays below 1. No new kappa.
